The original duel preparation now checks the two original living,
anchored character generations during the existing 0.2-second match
tick and again at the DUEL_PREP -> LIVE boundary. If a character dies,
respawns, loses its anchored root or the preparation references vanish,
the server clears stale combat state and live rig references, releases
both old prep roots, and transitions to DUEL_BREAK with the existing
20-second bounded recovery clock. A failed DuelCombatState.begin also
uses this cleanup path. No missing prep can silently leave DUEL_PREP
in its former dead-end. Only a successful begin consumes another bout.
One-survivor forfeits and score/award rules remain unchanged.

Pure Luau regression simulates 20,000 changing character generations,
malformed/missing prep, and both sides' readiness. Python contracts
require actual MatchService integration. Official Luau, full tests
and Rojo build passed on PR and merged main.
